thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway-us-west-2 (api/redwood-inference). Error spike started ~5m ago. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/alert/ALERT-502-5xx

lisa: saw it, paging now. @sam can you grab network/edge? @anjali on infra?

sam: on it, looking at Envoy metrics and LB config. grabbing `kubectl -n infra get configmap envoy-edge -o yaml`

anjali: i'm joining — scaling policies look normal. checking redis and backend health.

matt: customer reports timeouts for streaming responses. CX is getting alerts. @customer-success-bot please surface top affected customers.

customer-success-bot: Notified CS. Top 3 affected orgs: AcmeAnalytics, Shoply, Learnly. They see increased 502/504s and aborted streams.

lisa: priority: mitigate customer impact. short term plan: 1) identify config rollout in last 30m, 2) consider disabling retries at edge or reducing attempts, 3) adjust route weight, 4) scale backend if needed.

sam: found a recent rollout at 7392001000 by `deploy-bot` — LB routing + retry policy change pushed a new env config: `max_retries: 3` and `per_try_timeout: 2s` for /v1/generate route.

deploy-bot: deploy 7392001000 -> envoy-edge: set retry policy for inference route. CI: passed.

anjali: that retry + low per_try_timeout could be causing retry amplification -> backend overload -> 5xx cascade. observed increased upstream connection resets.

tyler: exact symptoms match retry amplification. Envoy retries cause more in-flight requests to backend; if backend is near capacity, you'll see 5xx spike.

kevin: quick test: can we disable retries on the route and observe? Command: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-edge --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/routes/inference/retry_policy/count","value":"0"}]'`

sam: doing patch now. applying... `kubectl patch` returned 200, envoy config reloaded (graceful).

matt: rolling weight down on the inference route to 0.7 as a belt-and-suspenders measure. `curl -X POST https://orchestration.internal/route/weight -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","weight":0.7}'`

lisa: ✅ disabling retries and lowering weight. watch grafana.

(approx +2m)

anjali: backend CPU just dipped, connection errors trending down. 5xx rate decreased from 18% -> 6% in the last 90s.

incident-bot: Alert update: 5xx rate dropped to 6% (was 18%). Time series: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/5xx-overview

tyler: good. still seeing occasional 504s from long-running LLM tokens. might need to increase per_try_timeout but only after retries are off.

sam: recommendation: revert the retry policy change for now and run a canary of a reduced retry approach later (e.g., `max_retries:1`, `per_try_timeout:6s`) and add circuit-breaker-based fail-closed behavior.

kevin: on circuit breakers: current config had `max_connections: 10000`, `max_pending_requests: 2000`, `max_requests: 5000`. those pending limits likely allowed queueing that amplified retries. Suggest lowering `max_pending_requests` to 300 for inference route and enable `track_remaining_attempts` telemetry.

matt: applying circuit breaker tweak to canary subset (10% of edge) to observe. patch applied to canary pool.

anjali: also increasing backend replicas by +2 to relieve pressure while we validate config changes. `k scale deployment inference-backend --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy inference-backend -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+2))`

lisa: oncall handoff: i'll stay on until recovery confirmed. @sam please coordinate rollback PR for retry change and include test plan for canary.

sam: creating rollback PR referencing deploy 7392001000. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/edge-config/pull/3827

(approx +8m)

matt: canary circuit breaker tweak looks healthier — pending queues are smaller, tail latencies dropping.

deploy-bot: Pull request merged, triggering config rollout to edge canary group. build: 7392001230 -> will roll to 10% then 100% after 5m if healthy.

lisa: monitoring. alert thresholds temporarily widened to avoid flapping while we validate.

(approx +12m)

anjali: metrics now: 5xx steady at 1.2%, overall latency normalized, streaming sessions restored for 95% of active connections. CS reports major customers back to normal.

customer-success-bot: CS update: AcmeAnalytics and Shoply confirm degradation resolved. Learnly still seeing occasional aborts but reduced.

tyler: action items post-incident: 1) tighter canary for config rollouts around retry policy, 2) automated canary circuit-breaker guardrails, 3) add telemetry to detect retry amplification patterns, 4) update runbook with quick commands.

kevin: I'll make a follow-up PR for circuit-breaker safe defaults and add `per_try_timeout` recommendations for streaming routes.

lisa: thanks team. declaring incident: mitigated. Keeping thread open for postmortem notes. If anyone observed anything else odd, drop it here.

sam: note: logs show a small subset of backends returned `HTTP/1.1 503` due to connection pool exhaustion. Will add tracing to identify specific hosts and evict unhealthy ones sooner.

matt: saved lounge: `kubectl logs envoy-edge-abc -n infra | grep \"upstream reset\" | tail -n 200` -> attached to PR.

anjali: adding postmortem draft to Google Drive and linking in this thread. link: https://drive.internal/postmortems/7392001234-retry-amplification-draft

incident-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED. Root cause suspected: retry policy change + permissive pending_request limits -> retry amplification -> backend overload -> elevated 5xx.

lisa: good work. handoff to postmortem owners: @kevin (infra), @sam (edge), @tyler (prod-eng). closing paging. :white_check_mark:
